Develop 2D and 3D CAD models for package systems, control cabinets, skids, and related equipment. Prepare detailed drawings including GA drawings, layouts, wiring diagrams, terminal plans, and cable schedules. Interpret and apply P&IDs, control philosophies, I/O lists, and specifications. Coordinate with system engineers, electrical, instrumentation, and mechanical teams. Develop project engineering documentation suitable to meet customer and internal functional requirements. Provide technical sales support for generation of customer proposals. Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident due to export-controlled nature of work. Experience in upgrading complex control systems, including managing cabinet system architectures and ensuring minimal system downtime during upgrades. Proven experience as a Package System Designer / Drafter in power plant or industrial projects. Strong experience in control systems design and drafting. Hands-on experience with 3D CAD modeling tools (e.g., Autodesk Inventor, EPLAN, Solid Works, Catia, Unigraphics or similar). Proficiency in 2D drafting (Auto CAD or equivalent). Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and P&IDs. Technical Skills. Engineering experience in steam, hydro, or gas turbine auxiliary equipment and applications.
